'''Alchibi Des''', known to his aquaintences as '''Alchi''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] salesman on a colony world.

==Biography==
Alchibi Des was a Chevin merchant on an unknown colony world during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He was arrested for the murder of [[Seth Horgon]], the son of prominant [[nerf]] rancher. While awaiting trial, Des was detained in the office of [[Marshal]] [[Jacobi Sterne]]. There he was visited by [[Malisan]], a young [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] male who served as an indentured servant working as a [[nerf herder]] on the [[Horgon ranch]]. Alchibi had befriended the boy and encouraged him to pursue his skills as a dancer.

After a secret meeting where Alchibi, offered to Seth Horgon and Malisan, Horgon refused to sell Malisan's contract.

[[Solk Horgon]] and his gang attacked the office of the Marshal, with the intent of hanging Alchibi regardless of guilt. The Marshal, Alchibi, and [[Malisan]] escaped the [[Lightfight|fire fight]] by way of a secret tunnel after Malisan confessed to the killing.<ref name="FH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alchibi Des appeared in the role-playing sourcebook ''[[Far Horizons]]'' released in [[2014]] and developed by [[Sam Stewart]].<ref name="FH" />
